subject: [Built-in AI EPP] [⚠️ WebMCP API breaking change] provideContext() and clearContext() are removed
snippet:

 clearContext() methods starting in Chrome 147.0.7721.0
 <https://chromiumdash.appspot.com/commit/e04dbede55ecb211f3fe2c9e47c7c5d3fced355b>.
 This change, detailed in issue #101
